tools.name: iriscrm_list_leads
tools.description: List CRM leads (sales prospects) with filters by group, merchant id, campaign, source, status, status category, owner user, and a date range. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /leads.

tools.name: iriscrm_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead with its field values (status, owner, contact details, custom fields). IRIS CRM Open API: GET /leads/{leadId}.

tools.name: iriscrm_list_lead_notes
tools.description: List the notes on one lead, optionally from one note tab. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /leads/{leadId}/notes.

tools.name: iriscrm_list_lead_fields
tools.description: List the lead field definitions and their ids. Use the ids before reading or updating a field value. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /leads/fields.

tools.name: iriscrm_list_merchants
tools.description: List merchants (processing accounts) with filters by group, processor, merchant id, name, status, active flag, and a date range. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /merchants.

tools.name: iriscrm_list_users
tools.description: List CRM users (sales reps and admins) with their class and active flag. IRIS CRM Open API: GET /users/list.
